listings.name: Maslak Koru
listings.desc: Maslak Koru is a luxury development on a 49,360 m² site in Maslak, with 65% green areas and open views of Belgrade Forest. Eight residential blocks of up to 15 floors hold 754 apartments from 1+1 to 5+1, with 2.85–3.00 m ceiling heights. The project also includes a commercial zone with offices, a Marriott Bonvoy block and 44 shops, plus social facilities with three swimming pools, a 1,000 m² gym, sauna, steam room, pilates studio, playground and underground parking.

listings.name: Pearl Topkapı
listings.desc: Pearl Residence Topkapı is a 15-floor tower on the E5 highway in Topkapı, with metro, metrobus and tram within walking distance — Fatih 5 minutes, Taksim Square 15 minutes and Istanbul Airport 35 minutes away. The project offers 1+1 apartments of 65–92 m² and 2+1 apartments of 80–129 m², with panoramic views, open and covered parking, a gym with open views and landscaped gardens. It is eligible for Turkish Citizenship.

listings.name: Yeni Eyüp Evleri
listings.desc: Yeni Eyüp Evleri is a modern residential project in Eyüpsultan, on the European side of Istanbul, set on approximately 10,700 m² of land with 7 residential blocks and around 389 apartments. It offers 1+1 to 3+1 layouts suited to both small households and families. Residents enjoy a fitness centre, sauna, children's playground, cafés and green landscaped areas, along with parking and 24/7 security. The project is built to earthquake regulations and offers easy access to public transport, including metro and tram connections, with quick links to Levent, Maslak and Taksim.
